title: Middle-Schoolers Are Seeking Out AI Friends Instead of Real Human Ones
why_it_matters_hint: Children of middle-school age and their parents are affected; the headline alone does not say how many students or how the Journal measured it.
event_date: Not stated (WSJ item published 3 Oct 2026, 03:20 UTC)
notes: Headline only. WSJ page returned HTTP 401 (paywall) and no other outlet carried this exact story. Vox (2 Oct 2026, 'AI found a way to make middle school worse') covers the same topic, a University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill study of about 2,300 middle schoolers, but it is a different article and is not confirmed to be what the WSJ used, so it was not used for this entry.
